worksheet.title: Offer Worksheet
worksheet.description: Turn your product into an offer: the complete package that makes a specific customer choose yours over every other option.

fields.label: Key differentiator
fields.helpText: In one phrase: what makes yours clearly better at the thing your customer cares most about?

fields.label: Minimum viable offer
fields.helpText: Describe the simplest version of this offer that still solves the problem and feels credible. What is included? How many variants?

fields.label: Offer summary
fields.helpText: Describe the complete offer: product, price, promise, and what makes it feel right for this specific buyer.

fields.label: Positioning statement
fields.helpText: One sentence: '[Product] for [customer] who need [key benefit]: [differentiator].' This is your internal clarity tool, not a tagline.

fields.label: Final selling price
fields.helpText: The price you will put on the listing. Must be above your floor from Chapter 5.

fields.label: Margin at this price
fields.helpText: Re-run your Chapter 5 unit economics with this final price. What do you keep per sale?
